title: Senior Director, Health & Safety Operations Europe
description:
About the role

Reporting to the SVP, Global Engineering and Infrastructure, the Senior Director of Health & Safety Operations Europe serves as a strategic leader driving safety excellence across our European operations. You will champion the development and implementation of robust H&S strategies, ensuring full regulatory compliance while fostering a world-class safety culture. This role demands a visionary leader capable of influencing cross-functional teams and implementing industry-best practices to minimize risk and achieve ambitious safety performance goals.

What you’ll do

  • Define and execute the European H&S strategy, aligning safety milestones with broader business objectives.
  • Cultivate a "Zero Incident" organizational culture by architecting risk-reduction programs across all operations.
  • Safeguard the business by ensuring rigorous compliance with local and international safety regulations and certifications.
  • Standardize safety processes across diverse sites using our newly developed, proprietary safety framework.
  • Partner with Supply Chain and Site Operations leadership to integrate safety into the heart of production practices.
  • Leverage data to track KPIs, providing senior leadership with actionable insights and performance reports.
  • Lead high-stakes incident investigations, ensuring deep root-cause analysis and the execution of effective corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary representative for safety matters with regulatory bodies and external stakeholders across Europe.
  • Orchestrate internal and external safety audits to ensure consistent best-practice standards across all regions.
  • Mentor and develop a high-performing team of safety experts, fostering professional growth and succession planning.
  • Pioneer the use of AI and emerging technologies as accelerators for continuous improvement and safety innovation.

What you’ll bring

  • 15+ years of safety management experience, with at least 5 years in a high-impact leadership role.
  • Subject matter expertise in European safety regulations, multi-national frameworks, and compliance standards.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: About SANOVIO SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily. Our software, SANOVIO aOS, uses AI agents to take over the tedious work: cleaning up product data, comparing requests and offers, bundling demand and keeping orders on track. It connects to the systems our customers already use. When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care. About the Role As a Forward Deployed Engineer , you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers . You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems , untangle their data and processes , and ship the solutions that make them successful. This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics , or bring experience in technical product management , product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense : what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees. Tasks Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers Owning customer implementations end to end , from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) an

description: About Delinea: Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure. Role Overview Join Delinea as Sales Engineering Director for Northern Europe and shape how the world’s leading identity security platform is positioned and demonstrated to enterprise customers. In this role, you will build and mentor a team of 5-7 Sales Engineers across the region, develop technical strategy, and directly influence Delinea’s competitive positioning in the market. This role is based in the UK. You will report to the EMEA VP of Sales Engineering, work directly with regional leadership, and own the technical narrative for one of Delinea’s most strategic markets. This is an opportunity to lead at scale, invest in people, and help organisations embrace Zero Standing Privilege. Key Responsibilities Build and mentor the SE team Lead a team of 5-7 Sales Engineers, supporting individual development, career growth, and technical skill advancement. Establish an SE onboarding program with milestones that drive demo proficiency in 90 days or less, and embed coaching and mentorship practices across the team. Identify and align KPIs with Sales Leadership so the SE function is clearly aligned to the business. Directly contribute to regional revenue, pipeline creation, and technical win rate targets.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
Principal Engineer - Contract

About this role

The bar has moved. Five years ago a strong engineer was measured by what they could build and how well they could mentor others to build it. Today, with Claude Code and agents, we produce quality work at a speed that would have looked superhuman in 2022 (Podium, PayPoint, Zuto, RL, OAG Analyser and others).

What separates exceptional from good is no longer typing speed or local craftsmanship. It is the complete package: architecture, deep engineering foundations, communication, system thinking, and the judgement to direct both your own intelligence and AI toward outcomes that matter.

Exceptional people at this level are not the best implementer in the room; they are the person whose specifications, decisions, and review judgement compound into systems that work in production and that others (and agents) can build on. They are a force multiplier, they hold a room at the highest levels, and clients treat them as the SME by default.

Your mindset

The mindset is the engine, and it is almost impossible to teach retrospectively. You are outcome obsessed, not output obsessed and you care whether the problem was actually solved - you resist the ego instinct to admire a clever solution and ask whether it was needed at all.

You are intellectually honest about uncertainty, taking a trust-but-verify approach and assuming the surprising bug is the one that will burn. You are deeply pragmatic, which matters at CreateFuture where pace counts: you have outgrown the religious wars about platforms, languages and patterns, you hold opinions loosely, and you decide for the systems in front of you, not the ones you wish you had.

You have a bias toward delivery: the smallest thing that works, then iterate, treating documents and meetings as means to that end.

And you are relentlessly curious beyond any immediate need, wanting to know how the database actually stores things or why a Claude Opus inference call costs what it does, which keeps you several layers ahead while the rest of the team is still reading the API docs.

AI as the accelerant

For a Principal to be truly exceptional, this is now already a first-class competency in your arsenal, not a side skill. An engineer who is brilliant by last year's standards but not fluent with AI is not exceptional in 2026. In practice that means:

description:

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As Anthropic's Public Sector Sales Lead for France, you will be the face of Anthropic to the French State. This is a founding, zero-to-one role: there is no public sector team in France today, and you will build our strategy, our routes to market and our first strategic relationships from the ground up. title: Research Engineer, Index Intelligence
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. We crawl the web continuously and cannot keep all of it, refresh all of it, or spend a GPU on all of it. Something has to decide which pages are worth indexing, which links are worth following, which pages say the same thing as pages we already have, what has gone stale, and what we should never have picked up. These decisions are worth more than most ranking work. The cheapest way to improve search is to stop indexing pages nobody should ever retrieve, and to start indexing the ones we are missing. Today they run on a mix of learned signals and thresholds someone picked. We are looking for a research engineer to own the signals behind those decisions, and the decisions themselves. Desired Experience You are comfortable owning a problem with no ground truth, where the first job is defining what the right answer means Hands-on ML experience with classifiers, rankers and calibration, plus strong data instincts at web scale You think in end-to-end impact. A signal only counts if a decision changes and search gets better You like working across teams. Crawling, indexing and retrieval all consume what you build You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Exa is an equal opportunity employer

description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. Je werkt op het bedrijfsbureau van Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed in Rotterdam en maakt onderdeel uit van een ervaren team, met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief. Jouw bijdrage is cruciaal voor het binnenhalen en goed voorbereiden van onze projecten. Je denkt actief mee over alternatieven en innovaties, met oog voor duurzaamheid en veranderende regelgeving. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt. Hier zit je op je plek Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. Tijdens deze opdracht analyseer je het volledige machine-inspectieproces en ontwikkel je een vernieuwde werkwijze die aansluit bij de huidige en toekomstige behoeften van onze serviceorganisatie. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar de inhoud van inspectievragen, maar ook naar de manier waarop inspecteurs informatie verzamelen, beoordelingen uitvoeren, bevindingen vastleggen en resultaten communiceren naar klanten. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het analyseren van het huidige machine-inspectieproces en het identificeren van verbeterpunten; Het ontwikkelen van een logische en uniforme structuur voor machine-inspecties; Het herformuleren en standaardiseren van bestaande inspectievragen; Het opstellen van duidelijke beoordelingscriteria voor de technische staat van machineonderdelen; Het ontwikkelen van een uniforme methode voor het vastleggen van metingen, bevindingen, foto's en aanbevolen acties; Het verbeteren van inspectierapportages zodat technische bevindingen overzichtelijk, eenduidig en actiegericht worden gepresenteerd; Het opstellen van een implementatievoorstel voor het vernieuwde inspectieproces binnen Customer Service. Het eindresultaat is een praktisch en onderbouwd verbeterplan waarmee Voortman machine-inspecties wereldwijd op een uniforme manier kan uitvoeren en klanten nog beter kan ondersteunen met duidelijke inspectierapportages en onderhoudsadviezen. Wij vragen HBO studie in de richting van Technische bedrijfskunde, Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar. Wij bieden Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand; Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt; Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software; Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te onders

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Toepassing van Augmented Reality
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Service & Support onderzoeken we hoe Augmented Reality (AR) kan bijdragen aan een efficiëntere en effectievere dienstverlening. Wij willen inzicht krijgen in welke toepassingen voor Voortman relevant zijn en hoe deze structureel ingezet kunnen worden binnen onze serviceorganisatie. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden van Augmented Reality binnen customer service, remote support en field service; Het analyseren van de inzet van de RealWear Smart Glass voor het ondersteunen van monteurs en klanten op afstand; Het in kaart brengen van benodigde procesveranderingen voor de implementatie van Smart Glasses; Het bepalen van mogelijke procesverbeteringen op het gebied van efficiëntie, reactietijd en servicekwaliteit. Het eindresultaat van de opdracht is een onderbouwd implementatieplan waarmee Voortman de inzet van Augmented Reality binnen haar serviceorganisatie kan beoordelen en verder ontwikkelen. description:
A career driven by you. At LeasingMarkt.de, we bring customers and dealers together to make car leasing more accessible, transparent, and efficient.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead product direction for LeasingMarkt’s Attraction & Loyalty team. You’ll help us build stronger relationships with consumers, from their first interaction through returning visits and qualified enquiries.This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You’ll identify the right problems, set clear priorities and work with your team to deliver measurable improvements. Your focus will be on making LeasingMarkt a more useful part of people’s car-shopping journey: helping them discover relevant offers, giving them reasons to return and creating better-qualified demand for our dealer partners.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product direction and roadmap for Attraction & Loyalty, translating customer needs and business priorities into a focused set of opportunities.
  • Improve activation and ongoing engagement through experiences such as onboarding, accounts, saved offers, personalised recommendations and useful reasons to return.

title: Enterprise Account Executive DACH (f/m/d)
description:
About the opportunity

As an Enterprise Account Executive - DACH (f/m/d), you’ll drive Contentful’s growth by leading the end-to-end sales process with our top-tier clients. You’ll be instrumental in driving adoption and engagement, finding new revenue opportunities, and creating customer enablement initiatives within a few named accounts. You’ll work closely with our partnership and customer success team to lead a consultative sales process by speaking to professional developers and business leaders in the DACH markets.

What to expect?

  • Self-generation of the pipeline through outbound motions in conjunction with marketing and BDR teams to help create new opportunities in regional accounts
  • Drive expansion opportunities with existing clients in the DACH (Germany, Austria & Switzerland) territory
  • Grow existing accounts by leveraging relationships and following our comprehensive “land and expand” sales model
  • Meet quarterly and annual sales goals by developing an account strategy and pipeline, managing internal and client processes, maintaining sales reports, developing market and competitor knowledge, delivering presentations to customers, and creating sales proposals
  • Manage RFI/RFQ requests with Contentful internal and customer teams
  • Refine and evolve our "land-and-expand" model in collaboration with Sales, Partnerships, and Customer Success teams
  • Seek to understand the digital experience challenges of prospects and clients while aligning the ROI of Contentful with those challenges to ensure a value-based selling approach
  • Work closely with Sales Engineers and Solution Architects to uncover technical challenges and opportunities
  • Develop innovative proposals, position complex pricing structures, and negotiate contracts and deal-closing requirements quickly and efficiently
  • Work closely with customer success & marketing teams to ensure that best practices of Contentful are shared and implemented at the respective customer

What do you need to be successful?

  • 6+ years of experience selling a technical platform working as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Business Development Representative (BDR), and/or Account Executive
  • 3+ years of individual quota-carrying experience
  • 2+ years of growing and expanding existing customer accounts
  • Demonstrated expertise in closing $100k+ opportunities

title: (Senior) Customer Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Empower every employee. AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn't sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that. Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI. More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round , bringing our total funding to more than $85M . Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Job Description As a Customer Engineer you sit on the edge of the product, inside the customer's environment: their identity stack, their HR systems, their security review, their AI roadmap. You take a tenant from nothing to hundreds of thousands of live users and you decide how the technical side gets solved, sometimes by designing the integration and enabling the customer's IT to build it, sometimes by building the first version yourself and handing it over. That includes where our AI goes live: agents in the frontline app, tool access over MCP, and the authentication questions underneath them that nobody has solved yet. What you can expect Technical ownership end to end: You own the technical side of enterprise onboardings, from the first architecture conversation to a stable live rollout at scale. Integrations that make Flip AI load-bearing: You design and land identity and authentication (OIDC, Entra ID, Frontline Identity), user provisioning (SCIM), REST APIs and connections into HR and ops systems such as SAP SuccessFactors, Workday or UKG. Advise and enable instead of absorb: You bring the customer's IT, their partners and our external development partners to a solution you would sign off on, and you make sure they can run it without you. Build where building unblocks: Where building is the fastest way to prove an approach or to unblock a rollout, you build the first version and then hand it over cleanly, with the documentation and the handover conversation that make it stick. AI where it meets the customer: You lead how agents, MCP-based tool access and agent-to-agent scenarios land at enterprise customers

Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions About the role We are looking for a bright engineer to help our customers solve complex technical problems across Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS portfolio. In this role you will work closely with vehicle software and tooling teams at OEMs and Tier 1s to ensure Applied’s solutions deliver maximum impact in advancing customers’ Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) strategies and in-cabin user experiences. Vehicle OS is Applied Intuition’s software platform for SDV. title: Senior Propulsion Engineer - Electric Engine (all genders)
description: Your Mission: As a Senior Propulsion Engineer – Electric Engine, you will drive the development of the electric engine for the VÆRIDION Microliner. You will act as VÆRIDION’s internal technical expert for the complete electric engine, including the motor and controller. You will be responsible for decomposing aircraft-level requirements into engine requirements, guiding technical decisions, and ensuring compliance with applicable certification requirements. Working closely with the engine supplier, you will critically review and challenge the engine architecture, detailed design, technical analyses, test results and certification evidence. You will maintain a holistic technical overview of the complete electric engine, including the electric machine, engine controllers, power electronics, thermal management, mechanical interfaces, control functions and supporting hardware and software. As a senior member of the Propulsion team, you will play a key role in technical decision-making, supplier management, testing and certification activities, helping to bring one of the world's most advanced electric aircraft propulsion systems into service. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the development and certification of the electric engine throughout its complete lifecycle, from requirements definition through testing and certification Act as VÆRIDION’s electric engine subject-matter expert and primary technical counterpart to the external engine supplier. Define, maintain and manage electric engine requirements, interfaces, operating limitations and verification strategies. Review and challenge supplier architectures, designs, calculations, simulation models, and substantiation reports, identifying technical gaps and proposing solutions. Evaluate the electric engine performance across its operating envelope, including efficiency, dynamic response, control stability, thermal limits and performance margins. Contribute to system safety activities, including Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Failure Mode Effect Analyses (FMEA) and System Safety Assessments (SSA), in accordance with applicable airworthiness and safety standards. Identify and assess applicable certification requirements, means of compliance and industry standards, including relevant aspects of EASA SC E-19, and ensure that certification considerations are addressed throughout the development cycle. title: Senior BMS Software Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: In this BMS Software Engineer role, you will join the VÆRIDION Airborne Software team within the Technology division. You will be responsible to lead the design of software required for our propulsion battery management and power distribution for VÆRIDION’s CS-23 all-electric aircraft. Your contributions will be instrumental in ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of the High Voltage Propulsion Battery System at the core of VÆRIDION’s novel propulsion system. Your Day-to-Day: Lead the design, development, and implementation of embedded software for propulsion battery and power distribution from prototypes to future airworthy systems. Implement software development processes and toolchains in compliance with aviation standards and regulations. Define and document software requirements, specifications, and interfaces for the high voltage electrical power system. title: SQL Developer – AI Prompting & Context Engineering

You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris’ most critical zones. You will act as the senior commercial owner for your territory, ensuring alignment between Paris-wide strategy and local execution. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions. You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory.

This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Commercial Strategy & Execution Excellence

  • Own the end-to-end growth of brand portfolios within your Paris Inner cluster

  • Ensure 5★ account manageme

title: RWE Biostatistician
description: 🏨 The company Resilience Care is a leading French remote patient monitoring (RPM) company and a clinical research partner, founded in 2021 with a mission: better care. We provide RPM solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, combining ePRO collection with AI techniques. Our platform supports healthcare professionals with early side‑effect detection for continuous and proactive care, and our patient mobile app helps measure and manage symptoms with tailored resources. Our solutions improve care pathways, enrich continuous patient understanding, and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in‑depth analysis of real‑world data. They are currently deployed in routine care for 35,000 patients across 200+ healthcare institutions, and also support around twenty academic and industry clinical studies. We put data at the service of care and therapeutic innovation, with the ambition to enable every patient to benefit from personalized medicine. 📝 Your role In a nutshell : you will help build and deliver robust statistical work for Real‑World Evidence (RWE) and Medical Affairs studies — from analysis planning (SAP) to reproducible programming and clear interpretation. Your impact : make study execution more reliable, faster and more reproducible (plans, code and reporting), enabling cross‑functional teams to make informed decisions. Your day‑to‑day Draft and/or contribute to Statistical Analysis Plans (SAP) and methodological documentation. Program analyses in R and Python; concept of SQL/Postgre. Contribute to RWE studies : design, methods and execution. Set up data quality checks (consistency, cohort rules) and document assumptions. Produce decision‑ready deliverables (tables/figures/reporting) and explain results to non‑statisticians (internal or external actors). ✨ Your team Your future teammates : Dynamic team with medical and pharma expertise Your manager : Nicoleta - Director Translational Research – RWE & Biostatistics 👤 Profile ⚙️ You are a good fit if you can : Apply biostatistics (survival analysis: Kaplan‑Meier, log‑rank, Cox; regression; GLM/GLMM; matching/weighting). Write clean, reproducible code ( R, Python; basic SQL). Work with patient healthcare data (quality, traceability, constraints). Produce clear statistical/methodological documentation (protocole, SAPs, reports). Build meaningful data visualisations. Communicate insights to diverse audiences. 🙂 You are a good fit if you have : High methodological rigo

title: Senior ML Engineer
description: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

title: Senior Stack Scientist
description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression. Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols. Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms. Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar). Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations. Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment. Management experience English

title: Fullstack Web Developer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Fullstack Web Developer to join our Web Apps team, in our Zürich office. In this role you will have the opportunity to drive development of new features, have a say in architecture and design decisions and have real impact across all the team’s projects.

The web apps team plays a central role at Auterion and owns the systems that add connectivity and remote interfaces for fleet management and operations. Our services are responsible for ingesting and analyzing flight telemetry data, managing and updating the fleet as well as integrating with other systems across the stack.

The ideal candidate is someone who’s a self-starter, can work independently, can work with ambiguity, can take decisions on their own and not be afraid to drive and push towards getting the project across the finish line.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Take ownership and drive the development of new features across all the team’s web based projects
  • Deliver clean, readable and maintainable code
  • Integrate services between edge devices and our centralized services
  • Handle new feature discovery, prototyping and investigations
  • Assist the Customer Success team in debugging and resolving customer issues
  • Monitor and analyze user usage patterns and other statistics
  • Push initiatives to clean up, upgrade, and refactor existing services to reduce technical debt
  • Maintain and improve integrations with 3rd party services

Qualifications and Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in a Fullstack web development or similar role.
  • Strong proficiency with the Node.js ecosystem, development and tooling
  • Strong proficiency with the Typescript ecosystem, development and tooling
  • Strong proficiency with modern SPAs (Vue.js ecosystem preferred)
  • Solid experience with Postgres/SQL (queries, transactions, views, indexes, triggers) as well as ORM systems (Prisma)
  • Solid experience with Docker and container orchestration
  • Solid experience with CI/CD pipelines (GoCD and GH Actions)
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Grafana)
  • Python proficiency is a plus
  • CH/EU citizenship required

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowan

description: Hoe kun jij bijdragen? Wil jij tijdens je stage direct bijdragen aan een veilige en gezonde werkomgeving binnen een technische productieorganisatie? Bij NX Filtration krijg je de kans om onze huidige Risico-Inventarisatie & Evaluatie (RI&E) kritisch onder de loep te nemen en te onderzoeken in hoeverre deze nog aansluit op de dagelijkse praktijk. Onze organisatie, werkzaamheden en processen zijn continu in ontwikkeling. Dat betekent dat ook arbeidsrisico's kunnen veranderen. Tijdens deze stage voer jij daarom een onafhankelijke review uit van de bestaande RI&E en het bijbehorende Plan van Aanpak. Je blijft daarbij niet achter je bureau zitten. Je gaat de werkvloer op, voert veiligheidsrondes uit, spreekt met medewerkers en leidinggevenden en analyseert onder andere incidenten, near misses, hazard reports, werkplekinspecties en andere beschikbare veiligheidsinformatie. Je onderzoekt verschillende werkomgevingen binnen NX Filtration, waaronder productie, logistiek, maintenance & facilities, laboratorium/QC en kantoor. Denk hierbij aan vervuilingen zoals nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. title: Offensive Security Engineer
description:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 15th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.

About the team

Security Engineering at the AI Security Institute (AISI) protects our people, partners, models, data and the research infrastructure that AISI's work depends on. We build secure-by-design platforms, automated governance and intelligence-led detection. We work closely with research units and technology teams so researchers can get on with their work.

We're now building an offensive security team and have three roles available.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced offensive security engineer who builds and breaks. You should be able to find and exploit vulnerabilities across cloud, infrastructure and application layers, and want to apply that work to containing and evaluating frontier AI models.

Offensive security testing is one of the key controls behind AISI's model evaluations. You'll run engagements against our evaluation and research infrastructure. That includes the sandboxes, Inspect (our open-source evaluation framework), and the supporting cloud, identity and platform services. Alongside testing, you'll build and own agent-assisted red-teaming harnesses that test this infrastructure continuously.

title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

In your first year, we expect you to know our top use cases better than anyone here, ship a product built for one of them that customers will pay more for, and have a defensible view of what comes next.

This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, research, data, and go-to-market.

title: Senior Product Manager, Search Infrastructure
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

title: GTM Engineer
description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent Kernel ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Notion already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY . The Role We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build the systems that take Kernel to $100m+ ARR. You'll own the infrastructure behind how we find, sell to and grow customers, from Salesforce and outbound to forecasting, renewals and expansion. This is a hands-on builder role, not a traditional RevOps support function. You'll work like a product engineer for GTM: find the biggest constraint on growth, turn a messy commercial problem into a working system, ship it quickly and improve it using real results. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you do need to be able to build with Salesforce, Clay, APIs, automation platforms and AI tools rather than waiting for someone else to do it. You'll also be Kernel's own internal customer , using Kernel to build an AI-native revenue engine, pressure-test the product in real workflows and turn what you learn into useful feedback for Product and Engineering. You'll report to Arvin Ashrafi, Head of Finance & Operations , and work closely with Sales leadership and the wider GTM team. What You'll Be Doing Build a better outbound engine: improve account targeting, signals, enrichment, prioritization, personalizat

title: Junior Compute Architect
description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. About the Hardware organisation at Fractile Processor Architecture sits within Fractile’s hardware organisation, which owns everything from compute engine definition and ISA design through memory hierarchies, on-chip interconnects, and the path from early architectural exploration through to tapeout and post-silicon validation. Architecture at Fractile isn’t a paper exercise — it’s built in constant collaboration with logical design, physical design, and verification teams, so that every architectural decision is grounded in what will actually perform in working silicon. About the team and role As an Early Career Processor Architect, you’ll join our architecture team to learn how to define the compute engines, ISA definitions and programming models that sit at the heart of our silicon. Working closely with senior architects and our logical design, physical design, and verification teams, you’ll get real exposure to performance modelling, specification writing, bottleneck analysis, and pre- and post-silicon validation — with experienced architects mentoring you as you build toward owning more of this yourself. title: Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our French EMEA business, generating opportunities via outbound outreach.

We have offices in Paris and London and we offer remote working from France and the United Kingdom.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last

title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient. title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship
description: Le poste Les Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSE) travaillent directement avec les clients afin de comprendre rapidement leurs problèmes les plus importants et ainsi concevoir et implémenter des solutions qui vont utiliser leurs données afin de résoudre ces problématiques. Nos clients s’appuient sur les plateformes de Palantir pour certaines de leurs opérations les plus critiques, et les projets débutent souvent par une question ouverte, par exemple : « Comment évaluer le risque d’incendie de forêt et, par conséquent, comment optimiser le réseau électrique ? » ou « Comment évaluer rapidement notre chaîne d’approvisionnement alimentaire et l’adapter afin d’apporter à temps une aide vitale ? » En tant que FDSE, vous appliquez votre capacité à résoudre les problèmes, votre créativité et vos compétences techniques pour aider les organisations à exploiter au mieux leurs données et avoir ainsi un impact réel sur le monde. Vous avez l’opportunité d’obtenir des informations rares et de contribuer à certaines des industries et institutions les plus importantes au monde. Responsabilités principales En tant que stagiaire chez FDSE, vos responsabilités s’apparentent à celles que l’on trouve dans une petite start-up, tout en bénéficiant des ressources, de la stabilité et de l’accompagnement d’une entreprise technologique bien établie. Vous travaillerez en petites équipes avec une supervision minimale et serez responsable de l’exécution de bout en bout de projets à enjeux élevés. Votre journée peut consister à discuter de l’architecture avec d’autres ingénieurs, à gérer des données à grande échelle, à coder une application web personnalisée, à discuter avec l’équipe dirigeante du client ou à établir une stratégie pour votre équipe. Les stagiaires FDSE sont traités exactement comme des ingénieurs à temps plein, et bénéficient d’une grande liberté et d’une grande autonomie dans leur travail. Ils assument la responsabilité des projets et des résultats réels sur lesquels nos clients comptent. Nos principes: Impact : nous gérons des projets significatifs et enthousiasmants qui rendent le monde meilleur. Responsabilité : nous menons nos projets du début à la fin, en surmontant tous les obstacles que nous pourrions rencontrer. Nous nous faisons mutuellement confiance afin de gérer efficacement le temps et les priorités et donner aux individus l’espace nécessaire pour réfléchir par eux-mêmes. Collaboration : nous travaillons en interne avec des personnes d’horizons variés

title: Senior Product Manager
description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! As Senior Product Manager in our Pro Business Unit, you'll own the mid-market product line end to end. You'll lead a "pod" - a small, cross-functional team of a PM or designer, and 2-3 full-stack engineers - through the whole cycle: identifying the problem, shaping the solution, building it, shipping it, and measuring the result. You're the single point of accountability for that team. The role blends product management, product design, and engineering judgment, all supported by AI tools. So we welcome candidates from a PM, design, or engineering background, as long as you're comfortable working across all three. You'll report into the Product Engineering director within the BU, alongside other pods led by senior PMs, designers, or engineering managers. Your impact at Brevo: Gather client signals and usage data and translate them into clearly defined problems, then shape the pitch — appetite, solution, risks and no-gos — and defend it at the betting table. Act as the pod's sole design reference: frame the user experience, make interaction and interface decisions, and create prototypes in line with our Naos design system leveraging Claude or our in-house prototyping tool. Run the build cycle against the pitch, using lightweight written status artefacts rather than recurring status meetings, and adjust scope rather than extend timelines. Agree on one or two measurable outcomes before the build begin

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Network)
description: Wanna join the adventure? As a Site Reliability Engineer with strong networking skills in our Cloud Infrastructure (SRE) team, you help the team own the networks that keep Loft running: cloud networking, VPN and site-to-site connectivity, segmentation, and routing across our offices, test equipment, and ground stations. You keep them reliable, observable, and secure as we scale. You coordinate with IT on the network components that interface with the physical infrastructure used by employees. You coordinate with the Test-Infrastructure team to ensure our test equipment is securely accessible. title: Product Manager
description: Wanna join the adventure? At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry. We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast. This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company. You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority. About this role: Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe. Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets. Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale. Define success criteria for each capability, an

title: Onboard Software Engineer - Deployment & Runtime Environments
description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit. The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. We own how software gets packaged, deployed, and executed onboard: from the tool that assembles and maintains mission-specific software stacks, to the Runtime Container Environment that lets partner and customer workloads run securely in orbit, to the Linux infrastructure that makes it all reliable. As more satellite programs come online and as we open our container runtime to a growing number of external workloads, the team’s scope is expanding fast. We’re looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who digs into an unfamiliar system, maps it out, and gets it shipped without needing the path handed to them. You’ll move between Linux internals, container runtimes, and CI pipelines, sometimes in the same afternoon. About this role: Contribute to and evolve our bundle management tool — the tool that resolves package dependencies, assembles mission-specific software stacks, and enables the Solutions team to spin up and maintain an ever-growing number of satellite programs Develop and harden our onboard Linux infrastructure : how services are deployed on the rootfs, what system manages their execution, and how we ensure reliable and recoverable Linux operation in orbit Evolve our Runtime Container Environment — the container manager and the full stack around it (base images, container registry service) — enabling partner and customer workloads to run securely onboard our vehicles Support scaling of the deployment pipeline as new hardware platforms are added and the number of active satellite programs grows Contribute to Product Validation — as the last step in the development pipeline, the team plays a key role in validating software readiness before it goes to orbit Design, implement, and refine software with a high degree of ownership, driving features from concept through delivery Participate in code reviews, design proposals, and the continuous improvement of development processes Must Haves: Strong understanding of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes, or similar runtimes) Deep Linux system knowledge: boot process, service management, filesystem layout, and failure recovery Experience with CI/CD pipeli

title: Full Stack Engineer - AI Marketplace

We are hiring the founding developer of that marketplace. You will work directly with the Director of Marketplace to take the platform from MVP to the system behind dozens of partner solutions, on a small team where you own features end-to-end and ship weekly. title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

title: Senior Specialist, QA
description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

title: Collection Operations & Process Manager (all genders)
description: Als Europas größter digitaler Parkraumbewirtschafter betreiben wir über 4.000 Parkflächen mit smarten Freeflow-Kamerasystemen. Wir digitalisieren das gesamte Parkerlebnis – von kostenfreien Stellplätzen über bezahltes Parken bis hin zu unserer eigenen App-Plattform. Bleibt ein Vorgang unbezahlt, ermitteln wir die Fahrzeughalter und wickeln die Nachverfolgung fair sowie rechtssicher ab. Als Collection Operations & Process Manager (all genders) bist du das operative und analytische Herzstück genau dieser Nachverfolgungsprozesse. Du steuerst und optimierst die europäischen Workflows von der behördlichen Halterdatenabfrage über den Mahnversand bis zur Schnittstelle für Customer Care und externe Inkassopartner. What to expect End-to-End Operations: Du verantwortest das reibungslose Ineinandergreifen unserer automatisierten Datenflüsse, wie beispielsweise bei der komplexen Halterdatenermittlung. Treten strukturelle Fehler auf, erarbeitest du verlässliche Fallback-Optionen. Compliance: Datenschutz und lokale EU-Vorgaben sind für dich die Basis für sicheres Arbeiten. Du sorgst pragmatisch dafür, dass neue Richtlinien smart und nahtlos in unsere Arbeitsabläufe integriert werden. Internationale Expansion: Du begleitest unser europäisches Wachstum, indem du unsere Collection-Strategien kontinuierlich an neue Märkte und lokale Zahlungsgewohnheiten anpasst. Datengetriebene Analysen: Du überwachst unsere Performance-Metriken (z. B. in Metabase). Wenn Zahlen schwanken, gehst du dem Problem auf den Grund und initiierst die passenden Lösungen. Du bist stark darin, tiefgehende Root-Cause-Analysen durchzuführen, um die wahren Ursachen hinter den Zahlen zu verstehen und datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen. Daten- & Tech-Affinität: Du arbeitest extrem datengetrieben, fühlst dich in Excel/Google Sheets sowie gängigen BI-Tools zu Hause und bringst ein ausgeprägtes technisches Grundverständnis mit.

title: Technical Architect
description:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

THE ROLE: Technical Architect

We’re deploying large-scale NVIDIA GPU clusters, including GB200 and GB300 rack-scale systems, into live data centres on tight customer commit dates. On those schedules, a design error found on site costs weeks and real money. We need one architect per deployment who takes the high-level design and turns it into something that can actually be built, then stays with it until the customer signs off.

This is a role for someone who would rather find the problem on paper than on the data hall floor. It suits someone who will push back on an inherited design or a customer requirement that won’t perform, and who carries authority through owning the design rather than managing people.

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:

  • Take each cluster from CTO handover to customer acceptance as its single design authority, so nothing is ordered or installed against a design you haven’t validated
  • Turn high-level designs and initial BOMs into build-ready low-level designs, hall layouts, rack elevations, P2P maps and cable schedules that site teams can build from without having to call you
  • Design the InfiniBand and Ethernet fabric, power, direct liquid cooling and containment to fit the real constraints of each data centre
  • Validate every BOM before it goes to procurement, and make part substitution calls knowing exactly what breaks when a line changes
  • Hold OEMs and integrators (NVIDIA, Dell, Lenovo, Supermicro and others) to their technical commitments, from FAT witness through to on-site issue resolution
  • Build the reference designs and building blocks that mean each new deployment starts from a known-good baselin

description: Présentation de l’Ecole et du laboratoire Créée en 1857, l’École Centrale de Lyon figure parmi le top 10 des écoles d'ingénieurs en France. Elle forme plus de 3 000 élèves de 50 nationalités différentes sur ses campus d'Écully et de Saint-Étienne (ENISE, école interne) : ingénieurs généralistes, ingénieurs de spécialités, masters et doctorants. Sa recherche d’excellence et son enseignement de très haut niveau lui permettent de nouer des accords de doubles diplômes avec des universités prestigieuses et des partenariats de pointe avec de nombreuses entreprises. Autour des thématiques de sobriété, d’énergie, d’environnement et de décarbonation, Centrale Lyon entend répondre aux problématiques des acteurs socio-économiques sur les grandes transitions. Ce projet de recherche sera mené au sein du Laboratoire LIRIS (UMR 5205), et en particulier de l’équipe Imagine dont les travaux visent notamment à développer de nouveaux modèles d’apprentissage et de vision pour l’analyse et la compréhension de données visuelles telles que les images et vidéos. Présentation de la thématique : Cette mission s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet Therm_I_Bat associant le LIRIS à l’entreprise CMDL Manaslut Ing. et dont l’objectif est de proposer de nouvelles méthodes d’IA et de Vision par Ordinateurs pour la détection automatique de défauts thermiques dans des prises de vues intérieures de façades pour l’aide au diagnostic de qualité des bâtiments. Description de la mission La performance énergétique réelle des bâtiments neufs ou rénovés reste souvent en deçà des performances visées en conception, créant un « energy gap » qui freine la décarbonation du secteur. CMDL a développé une solution robotisée capable de réaliser des campagnes de mesures exhaustives (thermographie infrarouge et images RGB) sur des plateaux de bureaux, logements ou usines d’environ 5 000 m² en une nuit. Cependant, aujourd’hui, le traitement est opéré par un expert sur un nombre restreint de fichiers. La multiplication du nombre de fichiers ne permet pas d’imaginer la mobilisation de l’expert, et seul un traitement automatisé sur la base d’un apprentissage du type Intelligence

Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun. Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre. Ce que nous offrons Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment. Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. title: Lead Software Engineer
description: Building the intelligence behind Solskin Are you a driven person who wants to make buildings come alive? We are Zurich Soft Robotics (ZSR), a Zurich-based startup developing Solskin – a climate-adaptive solar facade. Solskin is already running on several buildings across Switzerland, with many more to follow. In this role, you own the software that makes that happen. You also build the internal tools used by sales and the business team. Lead what comes next : With the CEO and CTO, you set the software direction and lead development of future products.
